result.question: Em qual combinacao de estado e ano MA/RS ocorreu a maior taxa de mortalidade em internacoes com UTI?
result.gold_sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT m."SG_UF" AS uf, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_uti, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mortes_uti, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade_uti FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios m ON i."MUNIC_RES" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE m."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS') AND i."MARCA_UTI" <> 0 AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m."SG_UF", ano) SELECT * FROM agg ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade_uti DESC LIMIT 1;
result.generated_sql: WITH taxa_mortalidade AS ( SELECT mu."SG_UF" AS estado, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE i."VAL_UTI" > 0 AND mu."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu."SG_UF", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") ) SELECT estado, ano, taxa FROM taxa_mortalidade ORDER BY taxa DESC LIMIT 1;
